closure_unit.outcome: Grant/access checks resolve the protected resource first and filter resource_grants by full resource_id equality, so each permission check costs O(1) in the principal's grant count with identical allow/deny semantics; proven by a focused core timing test (50 vs 500 grants) and the existing authority/denial tests.

materialized_acceptance.requirement: Each of fn::mt109_has_grant, fn::mt109_has_workspace_access, fn::mt109_source_read, fn::mt120_document_access and fn::mt120_loom_block_access first resolves the protected_resources record by (resource_kind, external_resource_id) through protected_resources_external_unique (parent/grandparent via that record's links), then selects resource_grants with account_id, principal_id, access_space_id and resource_id = <resolved record> equality, so resource_grants_exact_idx serves all four fields. No resource_id.* link predicate remains in those resource_grants WHERE clauses.

Allow/deny semantics are identical for every existing condition: live session; session and principal delegated_capabilities ('*' or the capability); grant status active, revoked_at NONE, expiry; account/principal/access_space equality; resource lifecycle_state active, owner_account_id, access_space_id, created_by_principal_id.status enabled; resource policy_version <= grant policy_version <= $auth.policy_version where currently checked; resource_kind/external_resource_id; parent and grandparent chain conditions (mt109_source_read, mt120_document_access, mt120_loom_block_access); actions and capability_ids; delegation_chain equality; the reconciliation_queue service-identity special case; the memory.propose/memory.read delegation rule in mt109_source_read. A missing resource returns false without error. Function signatures, callers, table PERMISSIONS clauses and the record-user execution context are unchanged; no privileged/root path is introduced.

Existing authority and denial tests stay green on the candidate: every test in storage::surreal::resource_authority_tests, plus the union's existing core authority selections (schema catalog/pin/upgrade tests, schema::tests::document_grant_single_live_policy_witness_controls_record_user_visibility, api::loom::tests::mt153_loom_route_family_authority_matrix, mt154_non_loom_route_authority_tests, knowledge_fail_closed_tests, knowledge_documents_api_tests, loom_atomic_receipt_tests).

New focused core timing test storage::surreal::resource_authority_tests::grant_check_cost_is_independent_of_grant_count runs as record user on the existing embedded SurrealDB resource-authority harness.
